pursuit: Self-healing scaffold quality: automated audit → fix-propose → judge → apply pipeline

base.note: R2 converged at architectural ceiling on corpus-side metrics. R3 shifts domain: instead of training the router against corpus labels, train a FIX AGENT against real scaffold-quality failures. The 7 seed fixes committed in R2 seed/* commits are the first labeled training examples for this agent.

trigger: Operator flagged that prior /evolve rounds had the human doing the harness work. Escalated per reflection 2026-04-20-self-healing-shift.md.
validateCommand: pnpm build && pnpm test && node scripts/audit-scaffold-quality.mjs

dimensionClaims.coverageRate: Of the 5 remaining broken framework layers (expo-react-native-ts, fhenix-contracts, fhevm-contracts, react-vite-ts, tangle-blueprint), how many does the variant's auto-fixer patch without human intervention? Target: ≥3.
dimensionClaims.regressionRate: Count of previously-passing layers that the variant breaks. Hard floor: 0. Any regression = auto-reject the variant's patches.
dimensionClaims.trainingValueScore: Does the variant emit training-grade data (fix attempt → outcome pairs) for future AxGEPA rounds? Boolean sum: does it log attempts? does it log outcomes? does it structure both as AxExample-compatible JSON? Target: 3/3.
dimensionClaims.codeSimplicity: LOC + cyclomatic complexity + new dep count. A deterministic rules engine scores HIGH here; an LLM pipeline scores LOWER. Track so we can honestly compare architectural shapes.
dimensionClaims.humanOversightCost: Does the variant apply patches automatically (0 cost, max risk), open PRs for review (low cost, low risk), or only propose in a file without applying (high cost, zero risk)? Tracked as a categorical so the operator can weight it.

constraints: All LLM calls MUST go through router.tangle.tools via createLLM() from src/lib/llm.ts.
Reuse src/training/variant_b/**, src/lib/vb-outcomes.ts, scripts/audit-scaffold-quality.mjs. Extend — don't fork.
New code under src/training/variant_{g,h,i}/ + scripts/variant_{g,h,i}-*.mjs + tests/training-variant-{g,h,i}.test.ts.
NEVER apply patches to registry/ directly from eval runs — only on commit from user-approved variant in the main branch.

The 7 R2 seed fixes (cli-ts, electron-desktop-ts, expo-react-native-ts, fullstack-ts, tauri-desktop, nextjs-ts, hardhat-contracts, browser-extension-ts, react-vite-ts) are LABELED TRAINING DATA — use them.

structuralAxes.variant_g_deterministic_rules: Pure rules engine. Read audit output, match error signatures (TS6046 target / Cannot find chrome / Cannot find @tailwindcss/vite / etc.) to deterministic package.json patches. NO LLM. Fast, cheap, zero-hallucination. Scores high on simplicity + safety, low on generalization to novel errors.
structuralAxes.variant_h_axgepa_llm_proposer: Pure LLM pipeline. AxGEPA-trained fix proposer with the 7 seed fixes as training examples. Signature: (errorSignature, familyPackageJson, frameworkPackageJson) → proposedPatch + reasoning. Scores high on generalization + training-value, lower on simplicity + safety.
structuralAxes.variant_i_hybrid_rules_first_llm_fallbac: Rules-engine handles known patterns (fast path), LLM handles novel errors (slow path). Adds automated PR creation for all patches instead of direct apply — patch → branch → PR → human review. Scores high on safety + oversight, moderate on everything else.
